}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:35.422
    | text      = "... with full conviction."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:36.743
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:37.203
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:37.462
    | text      = "And I am pretending that I'm some kind of a dissenting renegade voice when all I'm doing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = is kissing up and inf- reinforcing the status quo-"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:48.622
    | text      = "... in the strictest and most pathetic ways possible."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:52.182
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:52.722
    | text      = So...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:52.922
    | text      = "The caste system should remain like it is, and that's why I'm a rebel!"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:57.023
    | text      = "Why won't... They keep canceling me for saying that!"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:55:59.342
    | text      = (laughs) Right? "Why won't the king
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:01.582
    | text      = just fucking punish me for telling you all how great the king is and how awesome this kingdom is?"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:07.462
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:08.002
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:08.323
    | text      = So Tony sucks. Um, and I'm glad that I could get a little bit of that off, uh-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:12.523
    | text      = Ugh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:12.523
    | text      = ... you know, get it out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:13.842
    | text      = Ugh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:14.143
    | text      = Uh,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:14.783
    | text      = but Alex also wants to play a little bit of, uh, Tucker, Tucker's speech.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:18.582
    | text      = Oh, God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:18.882
    | text      = Who had the greatest speech...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:19.922
    | text      = Oh, my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:20.762
    | text      = ... of, uh, of the night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:22.342
    | text      = Oh, God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:22.363
    | text      = This was not his speech about how daddy's home.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:25.523
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:25.943
    | text      = This was not that one...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:26.823
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:27.243

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:28.382
    | text      = I remember that one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah, that was rough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = We might cover that in the future.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:31.962
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:31.983
    | text      = (laughs) I think he was losing it a little bit. Uh,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:35.042
    | text      = but, uh, here, here he is, uh, from that night, accidentally making a great analogy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:40.042
    | text      = Imagine if you're... And just pause for one moment. Imagine you're Donald
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:44.603
    | text      = Trump, you're from New York City, you become famous in New York City, you make your fortune in New York City,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:50.042
    | text      = and all of a sudden the leadership of New York City decides they're gonna destroy you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:54.203
    | text      = because they don't like your politics. And so they-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:56.703
    | text      = Boo...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:56:57.662
    | text      = Yeah, boo. Imagine if that were you, though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:00.762
    | text      = And they try and take everything that you have, they try and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:03.542
    | text      = put you in prison, they try and put your children in prison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:08.002
    | text      = If that happened to you, how often do you think you'd be going back to New York City?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:12.743
    | text      = How about never?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:14.903
    | text      = And yet he's here. It's like getting thrown out of a bar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:18.582
    | text      = And you think to yourself, "Well, you know, all my friends are in the bar."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:23.302
    | text      = And you approach the door and there's the bouncer like, "You're not allowed in here."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:27.122
    | text      = But from behind the bouncer you hear the cheers of your friend, "Come on in!"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:31.762
    | text      = And the bouncer hangs his head in shame, "Ugh."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:36.063
    | text      = He's embarrassed that he's working for the man trying to keep the most popular person out of the bar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:41.502
    | text      = And that's Donald Trump back in the city that produced him with no embarrassment at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:46.363
    | text      = So that's actually a really good analogy because people are almost
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:50.403
    | text      = never thrown out of bars unless they did something to deserve it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:53.603
    | text      = The bar wants people there because they, they make money off you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:57:56.582
    | text      = overpaying for drinks, so it's very much against their interest to throw someone out who's not a problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:02.103
    | text      = I've been thrown out of bars and every single time, I deserved it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:05.783
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:06.103
    | text      = I was never fighting or anything, but one
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:08.103
    | text      = time I did, like I was wasted and I tried to hug a friend of mine and he moved
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:12.182
    | text      = and I accidentally knocked over a table.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:13.743
    | text      = Time for you to go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:14.363
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:14.863
    | text      = Time for you to go, buddy. You had too much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:16.662
    | text      = Right. I fell through the table.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:18.323
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:18.622
    | text      = And the bouncer came up and I was like, "Way ahead of you."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:21.023
    | text      = "Hey, you and me both, sir."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:22.502
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:22.523
    | text      = "I'm out of here."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:23.103
    | text      = "Nope. Nope. Cool."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:23.802
    | text      = "I, who, would you like me to throw myself out?"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:25.762
    | text      = Yeah, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:26.122
    | text      = "I will happily do so."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:27.382
    | text      = I've been a door guy at a bar and it was not easy to get me to kick you out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:32.162
    | text      = There were some hard lines like harassing people or fighting, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:35.582
    | text      = the bar that I worked at at least, if the bouncer said you were out, you were
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:39.143
    | text      = not getting back in and you had it coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:42.302
    | text      = This is also a great analogy because the audience is like the drunk asshole's friends who are still
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:47.122
    | text      = at the bar. Trump's been kicked out because of his behavior
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:50.342
    | text      = and the friends are all too drunk and caught up in their friend's cult of personality
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:54.203
    | text      = to realize that he deserved to be kicked out of the bar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:58:57.922
    | text      = Maybe the next morning they'll wake up with a hangover and it'll hit them that their friend was a dick, or
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:02.563
    | text      = maybe they'll keep defending him and grow resentful of that bar
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:05.363
    | text      = who was just following the rules and protecting other customers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:08.382
    | text      = But that's a question for the next morning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:10.502
    | text      = As it stands now, everyone's drunk except the bouncer and they are in on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:16.882
    | text      = They love it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:17.743
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:18.342
    | text      = And this is a fun fantasy where you just force your way back in and you humiliate the bouncer, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:24.063
    | text      = in the real world, you're gonna get your ass kicked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:27.122
    | text      = A lot of bouncers I've known, the, uh, maybe not everybody but a lot of them I know are just
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:33.063
    | text      = pretty nice people who are waiting for someone to fuck with them so they could kick their ass.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:36.722
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:37.203
    | text      = That's a, that's a character type for a reason.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:39.182
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:40.002
    | text      = But all this kind of works as a metaphor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:42.042
    | text      = Trump has violated the rules of the country and has been thrown out of the bar by polite society.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:47.643
    | text      = He wants to force his way back in and take over the bar, and his friends/supporters, they're all wasted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:54.922
    | text      = and they're enabling him in his effort.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:59:56.842
    | text      = Tucker is stupid and an asshole, but he stumbled onto something decent here in terms of a metaphor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:02.203
    | text      = Yeah. Yeah. It's like, it's like if you got kicked out of the bar
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:06.762
    | text      = and all of his friends went with him, and then the next morning they bought the bar
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:10.882
    | text      = and turned it into a place where you could behave like Trump did,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:14.302
    | text      = uh, all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:15.863
    | text      = And then it turns out that nobody wants to live in that bar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:19.243
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:19.582
    | text      = 'Cause it's awful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:20.903
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:21.403
    | text      = People who are decent-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:22.722
    | text      = Other, other bars are gonna go out of business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 02:00:24.323
    | text      = It is, it is so crazy. It is, it is truly crazy that it's like...
}}
